description: Globe-LFMC, a global plant water status database for vegetation ecophysiology and wildfire applications is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Marta Yebra et al. Globe-LFMC is an extensive global database of live fuel moisture content (LFMC) measured from 1,383 sampling sites in 11 countries: Argentina, Australia, China, France, Italy, Senegal, Spain, South Africa, Tunisia, United Kingdom and the United States of America. Coverage: global (AR, AU, CN, FR); published in 2019. Formats: Excel, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC BY 4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
